name: Cross Tail
description: (Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Infinite Uses", Cross Tail is a glove-and-thread Teigu whose very durable flexible strings you manipulate with great precision, generating more thread from the spool with energy. Masters unlock Realm-Cutting Threads, nigh-unbreakable strings. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
